name: Astraea
source:
The world-famous model of the fairy tribe. 

With awestriking beauty, she is inaccessible to men, but she is the first of her tribe to fall under the spell of the hero.

[From [Url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_bb/23_Pure/pure_x_hollic.html]official site[/url]]
